enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +18: Passive: +18 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Charisma +9: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +9 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Cacophony: This weapon stores the power of a hundred blasts of sound within. Occasionally, this resonating power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with massive sonic damage.

Inspiring Echoes: When a bard wields this item, Anthem abilities that restore Bard songs over time restore them 40% faster (for example, an ability that restores a Song every 5 minutes would restore one song per 3 minutes instead).
Sonic Blast 4: This weapon rings with the power of sound, dealing 4d6 Sonic damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Sonic damage on a critical hit.
Healing Lore +16: Passive: Your Positive Energy spells gain a +16% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Devotion +111: Passive: +111 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Anthem: When equipped by a character with Bard levels, this item begins to hum an inspiring tune. Your bard songs regenerate slowly over time.

Silver: A complex process involving metallurgy and alchemy can bond silver to a weapon made of steel so that it bypasses the damage reduction of creatures such as devils and vampires. Silver weapons have 2 points lower hardness then equivalent steel weapons, and as such aren't quite as durable.
